label: GO step when choosing a1, in the first ~60 trials of an episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2) and almost only when the agent is about to choose a1 (93% of mass; the policy logit a1-a2 is in its top bins). The rate drops steadily over the episode: 14% of steps in trials 0-9, 4% in trials 50-59, and nothing after trial ~70. GO & action==1 alone gets F1 0.45; adding ep_trial<60 raises it to 0.64 (dev P 0.49, R 0.91, mass recall 0.93). The upcoming choice is computed by the agent itself, so no future random variable is used (model_act==1 does about the same, F1 0.64). It fires more when S1 is the good state and in episodes that start with S1 good, but adding good!=2 does not help. Previous reward or transition gives no useful refinement (adding prev_reward==0 or prev_common==0 hurts recall). A value-head band (7.6-8.1) adds a little precision (F1 0.67-0.69), but I did not record it because it is a model-internal correlate. Precision is still only about 0.5: many a1 GO steps early in an episode stay silent, and I found no observed variable that separates them. Misses (7% of mass) are low-magnitude GO steps with a2 chosen.
